requirements.description: Kill one hostile mob of the chosen type with the existing bridge combat policy (TacticalPolicy in bridge/policy.js plus the bridge aim math), driven only through the runner's observe/requestAction/releaseControls interface. Baseline for J4; V4 learned combat is compared against it. Set input.target_type to pick the mob; zombie is the default, so this also covers the old combat.kill_zombie case.

model.without_model: The bridge has no non-model combat path, so the trial ends immediately as a failure with reason requirement_unmet:<detail>. Nothing crashes and no controls are sent.

mob_risks.zombie: Trained and frozen-evaluated target in the combat contract. Lowest risk.
mob_risks.skeleton: Evaluated in the combat contract. Ranged: shoots from distance, so time-to-close matters and shield use helps. Expect lower success than zombie.
mob_risks.spider: Not in the policy's target features (no target_spider input), so the model sees it as an unknown target. Fast, jumps, and is short (aim point differs). Treat results as exploratory.
mob_risks.creeper: Not in the policy's target features. Explodes about 1.5 s after getting close: it can kill the bot, destroys arena blocks, and gives no kill credit if it explodes. Use a sealed or regenerated arena; consider mobGriefing=false in the test world. Treat results as exploratory.

success_check.time_budget_note: Per-skill budget is 45-60 s; this skill uses the 60 s upper bound.

reset_steps.command: item replace entity {username} weapon.mainhand with minecraft:iron_axe
item replace entity {username} weapon.offhand with minecraft:shield
